summary: LinkedIn adapter now looks up each company Page's logo through LinkedIn's Images API (extra GET /rest/images/urn:li:image:<id>) when the organization record only has an asset URN, so connected LinkedIn company Pages show their logo as the account avatar; failures/unsafe URLs fall back to no avatar.

statements.why: apps/server/internal/platform/linkedin.go:437-502 changes production behaviour: LinkedIn company Page avatars are now resolved via a new Images API call in both Page selection and metadata refresh. Only the test files are non-app.

misses.what: LinkedIn company Pages now show their logo as the account picture (when choosing Pages to connect and on refresh); the server makes one extra LinkedIn API call per Page without a direct logo URL, silently skipping it if LinkedIn refuses.
